scope: Produce one deterministic offline read-only descriptive temporal evaluation over exactly the 40 digest-frozen prospective prediction/outcome identities. Verify that every frozen prediction precedes the first assessment for its identity, then report aggregate Brier score, fixed-threshold precision and recall at thresholds 0.0 through 1.0 in 0.1 increments, class/family/wave counts, per-wave Brier summaries, and deterministic 95% evaluation-family-block percentile uncertainty. Select or recommend no threshold.
preconditions: The protocol, gate result, three prediction-wave results, store, reporter, and absent output match their frozen values.
The cohort contains exactly the 40 frozen manual-label identities bound in the reporter: six actionable and 34 non-actionable across eight evaluation families and three prediction waves.
Every exact triage score row exists and its scored_at timestamp precedes the first assessment timestamp for that finding.
No identity-level score, rank, suppression, source excerpt, or expected outcome is written to the report.
stop_conditions: Any protocol, gate result, wave result, store, reporter, cohort, chronology, or output-absence precondition drifts.
The report contains a non-frozen identity, omits a frozen decided identity, includes an abstention, or reports a class/family/wave count other than 40/6/34/8/3.
Any prediction timestamp does not strictly precede its finding's first assessment timestamp.
Any identity-level score, rank, suppression, source excerpt, expected outcome, threshold selection, or recommendation is emitted.
Any network/provider activity, store mutation, assessment, label, rescore, training, tuning, recalibration, production-policy change, OPT-003 status change, or branch merge is attempted.
result_boundary: One temporal evaluation result may record aggregate fixed metrics, deterministic uncertainty, chronology verification, input/output digests, and zero-mutation accounting. OPT-003 promotion or closure and branch merge remain separately authorized decisions after the result is reviewed.

authorization.required_statement: I authorize the OPT-003 fixed prospective temporal evaluation described by opt-003-temporal-report-receipt-2026-08-12.json, limited to one deterministic offline read-only report over exactly the digest-frozen 40 decided prediction/outcome identities across eight evaluation families and three waves, strict verification that every prediction precedes its first assessment, aggregate Brier score, fixed-threshold precision and recall at 0.0 through 1.0 in 0.1 increments, class/family/wave counts, per-wave Brier summaries, and 2,000-resample 95% evaluation-family-block percentile uncertainty with seed 2003, with ceilings of 10 minutes, 1 MiB new data, and exactly zero network reads, uploads, provider calls, tokens, cost, store mutations, assessments, labels, rescoring, or model training. Identity-level scores, ranks, suppression, source rendering, threshold selection or recommendation, tuning, recalibration, production-policy changes, OPT-003 promotion or closure, and branch merge remain excluded.
